command: /usr/bin/python3 run_ho3d.py --video_dirs datasets/HO3D_v3/evaluation/SM1 --out_dir outputs/exp_batch_20260927/noop/ho3d --mask_dir masks_SAM2 --backend gaussian --gs_feedback noop --gs_initial_steps 500 --gs_update_steps 500
runner_config_text:
# 2DGS + observation-gated prior lifecycle (milestone ③ v1, adopted
# 2026-09-01 — see PRIOR_LIFECYCLE_RESULTS.md).
#
# Built on config_gs_2dgs_1mm.yml. The lifecycle requires densification and
# opacity reset disabled (v1 constraint) and manages a SAM3D surfel prior:
# UNSEEN frozen/protected, VERIFIED trained, CONTRADICTED removed.
voxel_size: 0.001
novelty_distance: 0.001

renderer: 2dgs

depth_loss_weight: 1.0
depth_huber_delta_m: 0.03
depth_alpha_threshold: 0.05

normal_consistency_weight: 0.05
normal_consistency_start_step: 7000
distortion_weight: 0.0

strategy:
  refine_start_iter: 100000000
  refine_stop_iter: 100000001
  reset_every: 100000000

update_strategy:
  refine_start_iter: 100000000
  refine_stop_iter: 100000001

prior_lifecycle:
  enabled: true
note: pose source for EXP_BATCH_20260927 (batch-1 ctrl outputs lack color/depth/mask/per-frame poses_before_gs after cleanup)
